mapper.select: SELECT org_id, org_name, org_code, parent_id, parent_name, org_level, org_type, leader, contact, phone, email, address, status, description, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time FROM finance_org WHERE org_id = #{orgId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO finance_org ( org_id, org_name, org_code, parent_id, parent_name, org_level, org_type, leader, contact, phone, email, address, status, description, create_by, create_time ) VALUES ( #{org.orgId}, #{org.orgName}, #{org.orgCode}, #{org.parentId}, #{org.parentName}, #{org.orgLevel}, #{org.orgType}, #{org.leader}, #{org.contact}, #{org.phone}, #{org.email}, #{org.address}, #{org.status}, #{org.description}, #{org.createBy}, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE finance_org SET org_name = #{org.orgName}, org_code = #{org.orgCode}, parent_id = #{org.parentId}, parent_name = #{org.parentName}, org_level = #{org.orgLevel}, org_type = #{org.orgType}, leader = #{org.leader}, contact = #{org.contact}, phone = #{org.phone}, email = #{org.email}, address = #{org.address}, status = #{org.status}, description = #{org.description}, update_by = #{org.updateBy}, update_time = SYSDATE WHERE org_id = #{org.orgId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_FINANCE_ORG_COMPANY ( ORG_ID, COMPANY_ID, COMPANY_NAME, TENANT_ID, CREATE_TIME ) VALUES ( #{data.orgId}, #{data.companyId}, #{data.companyName}, #{data.tenantId}, SYSDATE )
